port.description: TCP port for client connections (must be open in firewall)

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind to (empty = all interfaces)

ssl_cert_path.description: Absolute path to TLS certificate (required for encrypted connections)

ssl_key_path.description: Absolute path to TLS private key (must be readable by mumble user)

ssl_ca_path.description: Optional: Path to CA chain file for client certificate validation

server_password.description: Password required for clients to connect (leave blank for open server)

super_user_password.description: Initial SuperUser password; must be set once during first login

max_bandwidth.description: Total audio bandwidth in bits per second (per-user limit is 1/3 of this)

log_file_path.description: Path to log file; empty means write to stderr/stdout

web_enable.description: Enable built-in web interface (requires external mumble-website backend)

web_port.description: Port for web interface (0 = auto-select; typically 8080)

web_host.description: Interface for web interface binding (127.0.0.1 for localhost only)

web_cert_path.description: TLS certificate for web interface (if enabled)

web_key_path.description: TLS private key for web interface

pid_file_path.description: Path for PID file (created on startup)

bonjour_enabled.description: Publish server via Bonjour/Zeroconf for automatic discovery

enable_registration.description: Allow users to register accounts via client (insecure on public servers)

opus_dtx.description: Enable discontinuous transmission to save bandwidth during silence

silence_threshold.description: Silence detection threshold (0.0–1.0); lower = more sensitive

udp_packet_size.description: Max UDP packet size in bytes (0 = auto-detect)

ice_no_tcp.description: Disable TCP fallback for ICE connectivity (legacy clients only)

static_users.description: Predefined user accounts (not recommended for production)

acl.description: List of access control rules (e.g., 'admin' or 'whitelist')

default_channels.description: Predefined channels created on first startup

max_users.description: Max users in channel (0 = inherit server limit)
